svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Structure architect: outline and evidence map (agent); Outline approval (stop); Outline, evidence map, word count per section (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake agent: config.md [D24]; the research question in full, a research report and its bibliography read [AV1, AV15], the type by the selection table [AV3]; a file given in words found by search [AQ] (stop); Session: the search themes, clusters of the method areas, each with its scope and target range, in config.md Decisions [The academic-paper strategist] (question); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1, review-theme-1.md and refs-theme-1.bib; each included source confirmed by a live lookup, an unconfirmed one excluded and listed [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge jobs, all at once: a leads job per theme run, the intersections and the venues [CA] [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, citation rounds over the merged core set [CA]: refs and cited-by jobs of at most 40 works, until the loop closes, at most 8 [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); The citation loop does not close: the works not collected and the rounds run; another 8 rounds, or go on with the works named [The lit-review run under the rules] (stop); Literature strategist, merge run, fresh: the duplicates removed, the report over the merged set, the gates computed, a gate's search a job the session starts; review.md, refs.bib [CA] [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, for one search theme; the search always runs, and it does not start without a research question [J, AV15] (ruled, only when needed); The strategist, one search theme: each included source confirmed by a live lookup, an unconfirmed one excluded and listed [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J] (stop); Planner: outline and evidence map, argument map with its weak-argument signs [D43, T]; the structure checked against the question and the materials [AV18] (ruled); Literature strategist, resumed or fresh: the sections that need literature and have no source [AD1, BR]; the merge run's after theme runs [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled); Planner again: assigns what was found [AD1] (ruled); Outline approval (stop); Planner: asks what is wrong with the structure, writes 2 alternatives; your own structure is followed as user-customized [AD2] (ruled); Outline, evidence map and argument map [T] (ruled).
